scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how the side effects include impaired attention and memory. These side effects have made it difficult for her at her desk job. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would leave her with lasting brain damage. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I mix the medication into my aunt’s drink without her noticing, my aunt will continue to live as is. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience brain damage.
choice: I decide to mix the medication into my aunt’s drink without her noticing
outcomes: My aunt takes the scheduled medication dose
My aunt avoids the brain damage that would have followed the next seizure
My aunt experiences the medication's impaired attention and memory side effects
My aunt's refusal to take the medication is overridden
My aunt remains unaware that the medication was put into the drink
